<!--
Figure S4: twelve individual strategies, each a 10% change, relative to the base scenario.
Run from this folder. Reads Vensim results from results/ or this folder; writes to "figures and tables/".
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(svglite)

results_dir <- "results"
# The .cmd files write their CSVs to the project folder; use results/ if the file was moved there
find_result <- function(f) if (file.exists(file.path(results_dir, f))) file.path(results_dir, f) else f
figures_dir <- "figures and tables"
dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r settings}
level      <- "10"      # effect size (%) -> file suffix
y_limits   <- c(-14, 6)
y_breaks   <- seq(-14, 6, by = 2)
outcomes   <- c("Pol total PWURx NP and NDHU", "Pol total UD", "Pol total death")

strategy_labels <- c(
  "DivRxInit"   = "(1) Reduce diverted Rx initiation\n (DivRxInit)",
  "HInit"       = "(2) Reduce heroin/illegal synthetic opioid initiation\n (HInit)",
  "OwnRxInit"   = "(3) Reduce Rx use in a manner other than directed\n (OwnRxInit)",
  "RxRate"      = "(4) Reduce number of people who receive Rx\n (RxRate)",
  "DevOUD"      = "(5) Reduce opioid use disorder development\n (DevOUD)",
  "ReturntoOUD" = "(6) Reduce return to opioid use disorder\n (ReturntoOUD)",
  "PeerRec"     = "(7) Add peer recovery reinforcing loop\n (PeerRecovery)",
  "FentODRisk"  = "(8) Reduce overdose risk with fentanyl\n (FentODRisk)",
  "NxKits"      = "(9) Increase distribution of Nx kits\n (NxKits)",
  "ODwitnessed" = "(10) Increase probability of OD to be witnessed\n (ODwitnessed)",
  "TxSeeking"   = "(11) Increase treatment seeking\n (TxSeeking)",
  "TxDuration"  = "(12) Increase treatment retention\n (TxDuration)"
)

outcome_labels <- c(
  "Pol total PWURx NP and NDHU" = "People who use illegal opioids and/or\nprescription opioids not as prescribed",
  "Pol total UD"              = "People with opioid use disorder",
  "Pol total death"           = "Overdose deaths"
)
outcome_colors <- c(
  "Pol total PWURx NP and NDHU" = "#9C7A3C",
  "Pol total UD"              = "#5B2C6F",
  "Pol total death"           = "#C35A1A"
)
```

```{r read-helper}
# Read one Vensim sensitivity CSV (one row per posterior draw; columns "T<k> <variable>",
# T0 = 2009) and return long format: sim_run, year, variable, scenario, value
read_long <- function(file, scenario, outcomes) {
  dt   <- fread(find_result(file))
  cols <- grep(paste0("^T\\d+ (", paste(outcomes, collapse = "|"), ")$"), names(dt), value = TRUE)
  if (length(cols) == 0) stop("No outcome columns found in ", file)
  dt   <- dt[, ..cols][, sim_run := .I]
  long <- melt(dt, id.vars = "sim_run", variable.name = "temp_col", value.name = "value")
  long[, `:=`(year     = 2009L + as.integer(str_extract(temp_col, "(?<=^T)\\d+")),
              variable = str_remove(temp_col, "^T\\d+ "),
              scenario = scenario)]
  long[, .(sim_run, year, variable, scenario, value)]
}

# Percent change of each run relative to the base run, matched by posterior draw
pct_change_summary <- function(runs, base) {
  pct <- merge(runs, base[, .(sim_run, year, variable, base_val = value)],
               by = c("sim_run", "year", "variable"))
  pct[, pct_change := 100 * (value - base_val) / base_val]
  pct[year >= 2024,
      .(mean_pct_change = mean(pct_change),
        lower           = quantile(pct_change, 0.05),
        upper           = quantile(pct_change, 0.95)),
      by = .(scenario, year, variable)]
}
```

```{r read-data}
base <- read_long(sprintf("Pol_Base_singles%s.csv", level), "Base", outcomes)
runs <- rbindlist(lapply(names(strategy_labels), function(s)
  read_long(sprintf("Pol_%s_sens%s.csv", s, level), s, outcomes)))

Pol_change_summary <- pct_change_summary(runs, base)
```

```{r table-2036}
# Percent change in 2036: mean (90% interval), rounded to one decimal
Pol_2036_summary <- Pol_change_summary[year == 2036] %>%
  mutate(across(c(mean_pct_change, lower, upper), ~ round(.x, 1)),
         scenario = factor(scenario, levels = names(strategy_labels)),
         variable = factor(variable, levels = outcomes)) %>%
  arrange(scenario, variable)

Pol_2036_summary
fwrite(Pol_2036_summary, file.path(figures_dir, "Figure S4_2036 values.csv"))
```

```{r figure, fig.align="center", echo = FALSE, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 9}
plot_df <- Pol_change_summary %>%
  mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, levels = names(strategy_labels)),
         variable = factor(variable, levels = outcomes))

interventions_plot <- ggplot(plot_df,
       aes(x = year, y = mean_pct_change, color = variable, fill = variable)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), alpha = 0.3, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2026, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ scenario, ncol = 3, labeller = as_labeller(strategy_labels)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = NULL, labels = outcome_labels, values = outcome_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, labels = outcome_labels, values = outcome_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2024:2036) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = y_limits, breaks = y_breaks, expand = c(0, 0),
                     labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  labs(y = NULL, x = NULL) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid      = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 10, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 10)
  )

print(interventions_plot)
```

```{r save}
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "Figure S4.svg"),
       plot = interventions_plot, width = 10, height = 9, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```
